topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: The world moves in strange ways, more so in the towns where folk see more of the stonework and less of the soil. I heard tell of a neighbor's cart, not a horse-drawn one but the kind that roars and smokes, being taken away from its rightful place. Seems the folk who live by iron rules and coin found some fault with it. They say it's not meant to be there, but where else should it be but on the ground they own? I reckon the true lord of the land would see no reason in such a tale, but the ways of the town are as muddled as a storm-clouded sky. May the saints watch over us and guide us, for we are but simple souls in a world grown too clever by half.
